acceptance: The release PR is merged and its body records Gate 1 (each step above, starting with the direct migration of the seeded copy and including the 0.12.0 client's E_SCHEMA refusal) and Gate 2 (validate against BenchBox todo-state passes).
BenchBox todo-state is not migrated by the gates: a live read after Gate 2 shows the same schema_version as before.
The release tag is pushed and the GitHub release carries the wheel, the sdist and SHA256SUMS.
context: Owner decision 2026-11-01 (owner answer in the choice dialog, BenchBox session 01a19729, 2026-11-01): "Both repos; agent tags the release after gates" [option text: the agent opens and merges PRs in joeharris76/todo-db and joeharris76/skill-sync-skills, and pushes the todo-db release tag once the release PR merges with Gate 1 (scratch remote) and Gate 2 (validate against BenchBox todo-state) recorded]. Decision gate: do not tag if either gate is missing or failed. Never cut over or write the real BenchBox store in a gate, and never push the seeded copy to a hosted remote; the only real cutover happens in batch-loop-pilot-20261101. A pypi-publish failure from the known invalid-publisher configuration is out of scope, as in 0.12.0. Guardrails: work in joeharris76/todo-db under its own repository rules, on a branch and PR, never directly on main; never patch the vendored wheel in BenchBox; one server stays one worker identity (todo-db ADRs 0003 and 0006); every new refusal fails closed with a gate code and recovery steps; BenchBox line citations refer to the vendored 0.12.0 wheel (_project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.12.0-py3-none-any.whl), so re-read todo-db main before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring.
description: Cut a todo-db release containing the batch v2 work through a release PR that bumps pyproject.toml, uv.lock and TOOL_VERSION and dates the CHANGELOG, following docs/operations/release-gates.md and the 0.12.0 precedent (todo-db-0-12-0-release-20261031). Gate 1 on a local scratch remote seeded with a copy of BenchBox todo-state at its current schema (schema 1 on 2026-11-01) runs the full v2 flow with two real todo-db-mcp servers: register with the cutover, an outsider's take refused, a synced member prepared, a fix advance, a rebind and finish; then an 0.12.0 client refusing with E_SCHEMA after the cutover. Gate 2 runs todo-db validate against BenchBox todo-state, read-only.
